scope: All 253 unmatched revised page images for Units 1–7; byte-identical page reuse is handled centrally and is outside this report.
independence: Reviewer authored none of the inspected learner/key masters or TeX.
method: Each listed full page was actually opened via view_image at original resolution from its 150 dpi PNG. Acceptance was not inferred from text extraction, compilation, checksums, or thumbnail/contact sheets.
checks: Table row and column axes, titles and labels
Complete compact finite-paradigm display with 1–3 plural rows where shared; command and diagnostic scopes preserved
Full N/G/D/A declensions with number and M/N/F axes
Continuation, wrapping, page breaks, margins and collisions
Old English letters, macrons and lowered-e characters as rendered

hash_verification.method: SHA-256 of each current image checked against this review's inspected image hash and the comparison manifest; SHA-256 of each revised PDF checked against the manifest.
